facts.fact: The SARB says the National Payment System Act 78 of 1998 is the primary legal framework for the payment system, and that it issues legally binding directives under section 12 of the Act.

The SARB says its department regulates third-party payment providers and e-money providers, and lists designations of non-banks such as Yoco Technologies (2021) and Payfast (2024) as clearing system participants.
